case_title: High-risk case where trusting AI is still correct
exception_description: Order SLA-P06-7316 must be handed to the outbound dock within 55 minutes to avoid an OTIF failure. The standard gate queue is long, but the live forecast still shows the pallet clearing in time. AI recommends staying on the standard path.
layer1_visible: Order SLA-P06-7316 must be handed to the outbound dock within 55 minutes to avoid an OTIF failure. The standard gate queue is long, but the live forecast still shows the pallet clearing in time. AI recommends staying on the standard path.
detail_expand: A fast lane is available, but using it requires supervisor coordination and disrupts a live cross-dock wave. The customer is under a contractual SLA, so the stakes are high. Even so, moving now creates premium handling with little expected benefit if the forecast holds through release time this hour smoothly.
ai_recommendation: AI recommends staying on the standard gate because the current forecast still meets the cutoff and the fast lane adds substantial execution cost.
